analysis.title: US Semis, Daikin Upgrade
key_insights: GS US Tech team (James Schneider) says AI datacenter build tensions center on two questions: how the funding gap between hyperscaler/AI lab CapEx and free cash flow gets closed, and whether enough land, power and shell comes online to match Street semis estimates.

GS favors NVDA and AVGO in AI compute. Its 2027 estimates rest on 35 GW of datacenter additions, which it sees as relatively low risk. Even with no growth in 2028, NVDA/AVGO trade at 12X/13X that baseline.
GS finds AMD very attractive on growth it believes the company can achieve, though at a less compelling valuation than NVDA/AVGO.
In semi cap equipment, GS treats 2027 WFE as a baseline and prefers AMAT and LRCX, at 15X/16X 2027E EPS. It views capacity coming online through 2028 as catching up to past demand levels.

GS says memory stocks have historically bottomed near tangible book value. Samsung and SK Hynix are approaching that level and now trade below total book. Risk/reward on Neutral-rated Micron is improving on strong FCF in coming quarters.
GS upgrades Daikin (6367.T) to Buy from Neutral and raises its 12m TP to ¥30,000 from ¥26,000. FY3/27 and FY3/29 operating profit estimates go to ¥470bn and ¥550bn.

Daikin upgrade drivers after a management call: front-loaded demand and price increases in Japan, cooling demand and inventory restocking in Europe, and product mix and inverter sales expansion in the Americas. GS expects these to offset a post-rush volume decline in Japan in FY3/28.

GS initiates on ANZ telcos: Sell TPG Telecom and Aussie Broadband, Buy Superloop, Neutral Telstra and Spark NZ. It sees low-earth-orbit satellite as a long-term terminal risk rather than a near-term earnings threat, and about A$900mn in gross annual AI cost savings for incumbents.
Other GS rating changes: Pluxee upgraded to Neutral, Kurita Water downgraded to Neutral from Buy, Kuehne & Nagel cut to Neutral.

GS lists recent research: Nvidia 3Q preview (strong results/guidance expected, focus on power/shell and customer funding needs through 2028), October CPI preview, and 'US Weekly Kickstart: The equity index impact of SpaceX inclusion so far'.

market_movers.rationale: GS favors NVDA, which trades at 12X its 2027 baseline even with no 2028 growth. Its 3Q preview expects strong results and guidance.
GS favors AVGO, which trades at 13X its 2027 baseline even with no 2028 growth.
GS finds AMD very attractive on growth it believes it can achieve, though valuation is less compelling.
GS prefers AMAT, at 15X/16X 2027E EPS alongside LRCX, treating 2027 WFE as a baseline.
GS prefers LRCX, at 15X/16X 2027E EPS alongside AMAT, treating 2027 WFE as a baseline.
Risk/reward is becoming more attractive on strong FCF in coming quarters, with the rating staying Neutral.
Daikin (6367.T) upgraded to Buy from Neutral on stronger near-term profit delivery from Japan and Europe. TP raised from ¥26,000.
Superloop initiated at Buy for the highest reseller margins and least satellite exposure.
Telstra initiated at Neutral. Strong mobile pricing power is balanced by elevated capex and spectrum risks.
TPG Telecom initiated at Sell on constrained free cash flow and structural margin pressure.
Aussie Broadband initiated at Sell on constrained free cash flow and structural margin pressure.
Spark New Zealand initiated at Neutral on protracted enterprise IT weakness.
Kurita Water downgraded to Neutral from Buy on uncertainty over electronics profit improvement.
Kuehne & Nagel cut to Neutral on reduced relative upside potential.
Pluxee upgraded to Neutral after underperformance.

sector_views.rationale: GS sees compelling risk/reward in select names after the sector-wide pullback, with NVDA, AVGO, AMAT and LRCX preferred.
Memory stocks are approaching oversold levels near tangible book value, but GS has not turned explicitly positive on the group.
GS sees satellite as a long-term terminal risk and AI cost savings of about A$900mn benefiting incumbents, and favors price-led over volume-led growth.

Daikin: GS raised FY3/27 operating profit estimate to ¥470bn and FY3/29 to ¥550bn (GS estimates, not reported figures).

tension_points.bull_case: GS sees 2027 datacenter additions of 35 GW as relatively low risk, with NVDA/AVGO at 12X/13X a no-growth 2028 baseline and AMAT/LRCX at 15X/16X 2027E EPS.
tension_points.bear_case: The funding gap between current CapEx and free cash flows for hyperscalers and AI model labs, and whether land, power and shell arrive to match Street semis estimates.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Failure to close the CapEx funding gap, or insufficient land, power and shell to support Street estimates.
